crossRefs.note: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have…
But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked…
but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge…
If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open, and there…
But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!
Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you, that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged?…
to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call…
for God is not a God of confusion, but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.
Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

translations.web: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?
translations.bsb: If any of you has a grievance against another, how dare he go to law before the unrighteous instead of before the saints!
translations.kjv: Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints?
translations.asv: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?
